name: Converter substation
summary: A converter-substation representation identifies a documented facility where an electrical conversion function forms part of the network connection.
description: A converter-substation representation identifies a documented facility where an electrical conversion function forms part of the network connection. Its actual conversion equipment and AC/DC boundaries require linked design drawings.
readingNotes: Identify which network quantities or interfaces the station converts.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A converter station is a system-level facility, not a single generic converter component.
